app_fee.value: The non-refundable application fee is $75 for all applicants; a $200 International Student Processing Fee is due only after admission.
app_fee.quote: You must pay the $75 non-refundable application fee.

also.quote: Upon admission to UWM, you must also pay the $200 International Student Processing Fee through your application portal

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are narrow: one doctoral application is waived for applicants who already hold or will complete a UWM master's, plus open-house waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: If you are applying to a doctoral program and already hold a UWM master’s degree ... the Graduate School will waive the application fee for one doctoral program application.

also.quote: fee waivers (contingent on registration and attendance at our in-person open house event)

gre_general.value: The Graduate School says not all programs require the GRE, so each program record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: Please be aware that not all programs require the completion of the GRE.

toefl_min.value: Regular admission needs TOEFL iBT 4.5 for tests taken after 1/21/2026 (79 for older tests); dual admission accepts 4.0.

ielts_min.value: Regular admission needs IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; dual admission accepts 6.0.

english_waiver.value: A degree taught in English counts only if you attended that institution at least one year and earned the degree within two years of applying; India is not named.
english_waiver.quote: A bachelor’s degree (or its equivalent) or higher degree from an institution where English is the sole language of instruction.

also.quote: You must have attended this institution for at least one year and your degree was earned within two years of your application to UWM.

notes: Dual admission (below regular score) requires a catch-up program. Several departments set their own English or GRE rules; those are on the program records. Chemistry's page says its fee cannot be waived.
